description.value: Walmart Supercenter (Store #1015) in Squamish serves as a one-stop shop for touring cyclists needing to restock on groceries, clothing, camping supplies, and general merchandise. As a large-format supercenter, it carries a broad range of food and household goods that make it a practical resupply stop on routes through the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The store is located in Squamish's commercial district off Discovery Way.
